scenarios.name: real_cli_recovery_preserves_one_browser_and_submission
scenarios.title: Recover from invalid inputs, missing cookie files and stale refs without repeating a trusted action
scenarios.workflow: Actual tool help -> start Chrome -> trusted approval -> invalid storage call -> returned hint -> valid storage -> missing cookies -> save/load -> stale ref -> discover/current ref -> unmatched URL wait -> one trusted submit -> inspect final pixels
scenarios.user_problem: An agent needs actionable failure hints while preserving the session and avoiding duplicate user actions.

scenarios.name: real_extension_storage_core_and_cli_match
scenarios.title: Use real extension storage through Python and fresh CLI calls on the same origin
scenarios.workflow: Own HTTP page -> Python batch write -> observed read -> matching CLI read -> CLI paired write -> reload -> persisted Python read
scenarios.user_problem: A correctly selected storage tool must actually work and confirm values consistently across transports and APIs.
